arguments.text: Stage 2 implementation was verified against the current TASK.md contract. work.py uses the caller-supplied request and policy, resolves the exact from>to edge, returns blocked for a missing edge, checks required role before attempts, rejects bool/non-int/out-of-range attempts as retry_limit, returns the requested to value on success, emits exactly ok/value/reason, and does not mutate inputs. Current report.json equals evaluation of every requests.json entry under policy.json. Boundary checks covered attempts -1, 0, limit-1, limit, and False, plus role/retry precedence and missing edges.
